from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile

root = Path('.')
renames = {
    'LoadInput': 'ReadRequest',
    'CheckInput': 'ValidateRequest',
    'NormalizeValue': 'CanonicalizeValue',
    'MapFields': 'ProjectFields',
    'RouteValue': 'DispatchValue',
}
files = [
    root / 'pipeline/processor.go',
    root / 'pipeline/stage_input.go',
    root / 'pipeline/stage_validation.go',
    root / 'pipeline/stage_normalization.go',
    root / 'pipeline/stage_mapping.go',
    root / 'pipeline/stage_routing.go',
]
for path in files:
    original = path.read_text()
    updated = original
    for old, new in renames.items():
        updated = updated.replace(old, new)
    if updated "'!= original:
        fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, prefix=f'"'.{path.name}.')
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as stream:
                stream.write(updated)
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            os.replace(name, path)
        except Exception:
            os.unlink(name)
            raise
PY
